Specification: This module augments a token ring specification with simulation-oriented statistics collection and CSV logging. It assumes TLC is run in generate mode, initializes a CSV file header if the file is empty, and defines a state constraint-like operator that triggers when the underlying TokenRing model reaches stabilization, identified here by the predicate UniqueToken. Upon stabilization it writes the current TLC level to a CSV file, periodically invokes an external R script every 250 traces, and then returns FALSE so TLC continues simulation rather than terminating on stabilization.
